annotation.authors_or_issuer: Дубровский, Д.И.; Ефимов, А.Р.; Матвеев, Ф.М.
annotation.summary_en: Philosophical article in Voprosy Filosofii asking whether intelligent robots can have ethical properties. It proposes building partial models based on an activity classifier to algorithmize ethical functions in general AI agents, and highlights the continuity of algorithmic ethical models and reinforcement learning for modelling uncertainty and pain-like moral learning.
annotation.title_clean: Может ли интеллектуальный робот обладать этическими свойствами?
annotation.title_en: Can an Intelligent Robot Be Able to Have Ethical Features?
key_provisions_or_claims: Ethics cannot supply engineers with a hierarchical normative architecture for computational implementation.
Proposes partial models based on a classifier of activity types to algorithmize ethical functions.
Any algorithmic model of an ethical system must account for continuity.
Reinforcement learning is effective for modelling uncertainty and physiological pain as a factor in moral behaviour.
